newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates close steady at 22.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates close steady at 22.625 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed unchanged at 22.625 percent after being quoted in a relatively wide range between 22.375 and 22.875 percent, traders said on Thursday.
"The rates will probably hover around present levels on Friday, too," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank.
She said Monday's deadline (of the banks' two-week reserve period) was unlikely to bring significant changes in O/N rates as most traders were already seen topping up their reserves.
